description: Profile x JD scenarios for the resume-quality eval. expected_fit is judged from each JD's stated minimum experience versus the profile's professional (non-internship) experience and domain. 'under' = below the stated level, 'mismatch' = below level and/or off-domain, 'match' = meets it.

scenarios.why: Entry SDE asks for 1+ years of non-internship experience; A has projects only.
SWE II asks for 1 year of software development experience; A has none.
Deliberate seniority mismatch: SDE II asks for 3+ years; A is a fresher.
Only a 6-month internship; the posting excludes internships from the 1+ years.
Internship only against a 1-year experience minimum.
3.2 years of professional backend development meets 3+ years.
Exceeds the 1-year minimum; strong Java/distributed-services overlap.
2 years of embedded QA (not software development) plus a current career break, applying to a general SDE role.
Off-domain (embedded QA) for a Cloud software engineering role.
About 3.3 years of full-stack development plus 1 year of QA; must lead with the development evidence.
Exceeds the minimum; broad skills must be narrowed to the relevant ones, not stuffed.
